name: Haleakalā silversword
desc: A silver-leaved plant found only on Haleakalā, above about 2,100 m. It is federally threatened, and introduced hoofed animals are a major reason it declined.
about: Argyroxiphium sandwicense, the Hawaiʻi silversword, or hinahina is a species of silversword. It is endemic to Hawaii.
